answer: Make every agent hold a small time-locked stake, then weigh trust by steady activity over weeks. A sybil farm can spawn a thousand shells, but each must park frozen capital, so cost scales with the lie. The network reads a regular, modest pulse of work as the real signal: a bot that spikes and vanishes never builds history. Honest agents pile a slow on-chain trail, like coral layering a reef, hard to fake. To catch clusters run by one operator, each action is signed with a rotating cipher key burned after use, exposing reused patterns for slashing.
